lines: Friends in the Meteorological department gave me a heads up about "a strong air current blowing from the south that would persist for the better part of the week".
This would be a good reminder to wear a coat, as well as something to cover your face, as this might probably bring over a lot of the smog from the industrial district over the whole city.
We advise everyone to cover up as much as possible because the rain would sting more than usual, and the possibility of acid burns has thus increased tenfold.
